bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Always keep the gun pointed in a safe direction, keep your finger off the trigger until ready to shoot, and keep the action unloaded.
core_mechanism_bullets: Always keep the gun pointed in a safe direction, keep your finger off the trigger until ready to shoot, and keep the action unloaded.
Insert an empty chamber indicator flag whenever a rifle is on the firing line bench and obey the Range Safety Officer cease-fire command.

primary_source_citation.title: CMP Eye Dominance and Sight Alignment Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Center the front sight post vertically and horizontally inside the rear aperture while keeping visual focus sharp on the front sight top.
core_mechanism_bullets: Center the front sight post vertically and horizontally inside the rear aperture while keeping visual focus sharp on the front sight top.
Wear ANSI Z87.1 impact-rated shooting glasses and hearing protection rated at 22 decibels Noise Reduction Rating or higher on every range.

primary_source_citation.title: CMP Five Fundamentals of Rifle Marksmanship Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Build a bone-supported prone or kneeling position and verify natural point of aim by closing both eyes for 3 seconds before opening.
core_mechanism_bullets: Build a bone-supported prone or kneeling position and verify natural point of aim by closing both eyes for 3 seconds before opening.
Release the shot during the 2-to-3-second natural respiratory pause at the bottom of a normal exhale while squeezing the trigger straight back.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Firing five 5-shot groups that each fit completely under a United States quarter at 50 feet requires a sub-1-inch center-to-center dispersion.

primary_source_citation.title: NRA Misfire Protocol and Bore Maintenance Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: In the event of a misfire or hangfire, keep the rifle pointed downrange for a full 30 seconds before raising your hand for the instructor.
core_mechanism_bullets: In the event of a misfire or hangfire, keep the rifle pointed downrange for a full 30 seconds before raising your hand for the instructor.
Run solvent and dry cotton patches from the breech to the muzzle whenever possible to protect the rifling crown from cleaning rod wear.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: After a 50-round .22 rimfire session, wiping lead fouling from the bolt face and running three dry patches prevents extraction failures.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Walk through the 30-second misfire wait procedure aloud and arrange cleaning rod, bronze brush, jagged tip, and patches in order of use.
